note: The setup's first extractor and actions (1090 s).
instructions:
Play the game well. Doodle Climb. Use the arrow keys: Left and Right to move, Up to jump (only while standing). Jump from platform to platform to climb to the top of the tower. The platforms move sideways; the icy ones carry you with them less. Falling costs the height you had climbed.
The status field is standing, airborne or won. level is the number of platform rows at or below your feet (ground = 0), and topLevel is the number of rows in the tower. Falling to a lower row loses levels. Each if* field is a physics prediction for one action. While standing, ifUp, ifUpLeft and ifUpRight predict a jump started now: result is rise (you land on a higher row), same or fall; levels is the rows gained; margin is how many px of your feet overlap the landing platform. While standing, ifNone, ifLeft and ifRight give staysOn (you are still on your platform after one tick), room (px to the nearer edge afterwards) and riseInMs (the soonest a jump would rise if you keep that move until then; -1 means none within about 2 s). While airborne, ifNone, ifLeft and ifRight predict the landing (result, levels, margin). RULES. Airborne: never press up. Take the option with the highest levels; if levels tie, take the larger margin, but move away from none only when it is at least 3 px better. Standing (not won): (1) If ifUp, ifUpLeft or ifUpRight has result rise and margin >= 6, take that jump: up, up_left or up_right, whichever has the largest margin, keeping the earlier one unless the later is more than 2 px better. (2) Otherwise, among none, left and right whose staysOn is true and riseInMs >= 0, take the smallest riseInMs; on ties prefer none. (3) Otherwise take the move with staysOn true and the largest room (keep none unless another is more than 3 px better). (4) If no move stays on, take the up option with the highest levels, then the highest margin. When won or gameOver, only use rule 3 and never jump.

actions.description: Hold nothing. You stand still, or fall straight down if you are in the air. Normal platforms carry you along; ice barely does.
Hold Left: move left at about 200 px/s, on a platform or in the air
Hold Right: move right at about 200 px/s, on a platform or in the air
Hold Up: jump straight up. This only works while standing.
Jump while holding Left for this tick
Jump while holding Right for this tick
